name: 60076 · Skokie, IL
findings: ZIP 60076 (Skokie) has 173 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (34%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (42% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60076 (Skokie) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 17 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 8 in similar places of this size.

observations.text: 22 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
